lines.en: I hop forward, one bounce at a time.

lines.zh: 我落地时压扁，又弹起来。
lines.en: I flatten on landing, then spring up.

lines.zh: 我的黏性拖得我慢半拍。
lines.en: My stickiness drags me half a beat slow.
Honey drips off me.
I hop; the ground sticks for a moment.
I hop toward the movement.

lines.zh: 我弹起又落下，声音很闷。
lines.en: I rise and fall with a soft sound.
I hop over a stone.
I spread flat when I land.
Every hop slides me forward a little.
I come along the ground toward you.

lines.zh: 我跳过草丛，叶子被黏住。
lines.en: I hop through grass; the leaves stick.

lines.zh: 我身上的蜜拉出一条丝。
lines.en: A thread of honey trails from me.
I hop in fits and starts.

lines.zh: 我弹到台阶上，滑了一下。
lines.en: I bounce onto the step and slip.
Another hop brings me nearer.
I rest on the ground, wobbling gently.
My surface flows slowly.
A drop of honey falls beside me.
I shudder; honey flicks off.
I am listening to the movement nearby.

lines.zh: 我的颜色很深，像熬过的糖。
lines.en: My color is deep, like cooked sugar.
I press against a stone and cool a little.
I hold still, stuck in place.
I flatten again.
My surface catches a little light.
I draw the fallen honey back in.

lines.zh: 我的表面泛起小小的泡。
lines.en: Small bubbles rise on my surface.
I stop, squarely facing you.
Grass still clings to me.
I hop once, a little closer.
You do not dodge; I hop again.
Honey drips by your boot.
I flatten and rise again.

lines.zh: 我的蜜爬到了你的鞋边。
lines.en: My honey creeps to the edge of your shoe.
I wobble, as if laughing.
I start bouncing toward you.
You pull back, and I stop.
I scatter for a moment and gather.
A dent forms in me.
A ring of honey flies off me.
I cannot stop shaking.

lines.zh: 我把摊开的身体收回来。
lines.en: I draw my spread body back in.

lines.zh: 黏住的地面被我扯下一块。
lines.en: A patch of my sticky footing tears loose.
A patch of my color is gone.
I bounce twice before steadying.
I stop and slowly close up.
I bounce at you again.
This does not interest me.
You set it down; I hop over.
I fold it into this mass of honey.

lines.zh: 它在我的蜜里没有化开。
lines.en: It does not dissolve in my honey.
I push it out and look again.
This sweetness falls a little short.
I hop toward your hand.
It sticks to my surface.
I hop back in front of you.
I stop asking.
You touch me; your hand sticks.

lines.zh: 我被撞得散了一下，又聚上。
lines.en: I splash apart and re-form.
My honey smears your clothes.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，声音黏黏的。
lines.en: We collide; the sound is sticky.
I cling to your leg.
I bounce off a little and return.
I flatten and slowly swell.
You shake your hand; I drop.
I leave a patch on your shoe.
I hop at you again.
Another is dripping honey too.

lines.zh: 我们靠在一起，边缘化开。
lines.en: We press together and our edges melt.
We trade a little honey.
Its color is lighter than mine.
We stick to the ground together.
We bounce at the same moment.
It slowly pulls away from me.
A thread stretches between us.
It hops off. I stay.
Each of us leaves a little behind.
I wrap it in.
I cover it with my body.
It sticks to me.
I bounce once and it falls.

lines.zh: 它在我体内慢慢沉下去。
lines.en: It slowly sinks into me.
It sinks in, then slowly floats up.
I flatten it.

lines.zh: 我用身体把它整个吞住。
lines.en: I swallow it whole into my body.
I leave it behind.
I hop away.
I bounce in your direction.
My surface tightens a little.
My hops are higher than before.
Each landing slides me forward.
You retreat. I keep hopping.

lines.zh: 你所在的位置我记下了。
lines.en: I have your position noted.
My honey drips faster.

lines.zh: 我的黏液先碰到你的鞋。
lines.en: My slime reaches your shoe first.
I start a run of hops.
My mark is where you stand.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面，一路滴着蜜。
lines.en: I hug the ground, dripping honey as I come.

lines.zh: 我最后一次落地，就在你脚边。
lines.en: My last landing is at your feet.
I follow in hop after hop.

lines.zh: 你往左，我改方向慢一点。
lines.en: You go left; I take a moment to turn.
Honey everywhere I land.
Step in my honey and your foot will stick.
I do not call out. My bouncing is the sound.
I edge closer by degrees.
You back to the wall; I keep hopping.
I wedge in a gap and pull free.

lines.zh: 我路过的地方都留着黏痕。
lines.en: Everywhere I pass keeps a sticky trace.
I hop a little higher.
Soon you will have nowhere to retreat.
I press against your ankle.
I hit your leg and stick.
I press my body over your foot.
I bounce up and come down.
My honey coats your hand.
That bounce goes wide.

lines.zh: 我贴在你的护甲上，滑不下来。
lines.en: I cling to your armor and will not slide off.
I knock your knee, again and again.

lines.zh: 你甩我，我掉在地上又弹起。
lines.en: You fling me off; I land and bounce back.
I spread over your instep.
I weigh more than I look.
I land and spread in a ring.
I swell first, then settle.
Honey drips off me.
The ground here has a sticky layer.
I hop toward the sound.
I bounce once to test myself.
My honey has not stopped flowing.
I wobble twice in place.

lines.zh: 我从泥里胀起来，滴着蜜。
lines.en: I swell up out of the dirt, dripping honey.
I leave a trail of honey.
Fire bakes me; my honey begins to harden.
On landing I splatter into several blobs.
Water dilutes me and I spread out.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我甩得到处都是。
lines.en: The blast throws me everywhere.
The arrow sticks; honey seeps from the hole.
That light heats my honey.
I grow smaller and my honey dries.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我跳得很高。
lines.en: Lightning hits me and I leap high.

lines.zh: 下面是空的，我掉了下去。
lines.en: Below is empty; I fall.
